about_short_description.short_description: GlobalCorp provides a complete range of leasing, factoring, and non-banking financial services for corporate, entrepreneurs, and SMEs.

product.name: Direct Leases
product.description: Financing option for purchasing easily traded assets like vehicles, equipment, and machinery.

product.name: Operating and Residual Value Leases
product.description: Leases allowing use of assets for less than 75% of their economic life without ownership transfer.

product.name: Sale and Leaseback Facilities
product.description: Allows businesses to sell assets to GlobalCorp and lease them back to improve liquidity and working capital.

product.name: Structured Leases/Syndications
product.description: Customized lease financing for large-scale assets exceeding EGP 300 million involving multiple financial institutions.

product.name: Domestic Factoring
product.description: Financing service where clients exchange domestic receivables for immediate cash at a discounted rate.

product.name: International Factoring
product.description: Factoring service for import and export receivables to provide clients with immediate cash flow.
